Chapter 164: Lend Me Li Luo for a Bit?

On Sunday evening, before the evening self-study session at the Fuyi High School.

The classroom of Class Eight was exceptionally lively.

The New Year's Gala was this Wednesday, and some students who boarded at the school had brought their instruments in advance.

Pipa, trumpet, melodica, flute... all kinds of instruments were present.

Yan Zhusheng had even brought four or five types of instruments, all of them relatively small and portable.

Before the evening self-study session started, the students who had brought their instruments would play them from time to time.

Zhang Guohuang was practically using his trumpet like a suona, jumping up and down as he blew into it.

Since Li Luo was a day student, he didn't need to bring his guitar today. He walked into the classroom with just his light schoolbag and was called to a Student Council meeting before class started.

As the Student Council President, Xu Youyu reiterated the important points for the New Year's Gala during the meeting, once again confirming the games and activities for each class and club, as well as the program list for the bonfire party.

"Your class's game is 'Guess the Instrument'." Gao Yuqin from the side glanced at the list of class games and leaned over to ask Li Luo, "Will you be participating? I remember you can play the guitar."

"I will, what's up?" Li Luo shot her a look, feeling a bit speechless.

It was one thing for this Gao Yuqin to string along Lu Wei from their class all day, but she also kept trying to get close to him.

Every time there was a Student Council meeting, she would find some excuse to strike up a conversation. Even though Li Luo was always aloof, she never tired of it.

But he probably didn't understand the thinking of this kind of girl.

Originally, Li Luo had thought that since he was often seen with beautiful girls like Yan Zhusheng, Ying Chanxi, and Xu Youyu, Gao Yuqin would stay away from him out of a sense of inferiority.

But it turned out that this was only effective at the beginning; recently, it had made her even more persistent.

Actually, it was because this type of girl had a slightly different way of thinking.

In Gao Yuqin's view, Li Luo was able to get along with so many beautiful girls in a friendly and harmonious way.

So.

If she could also be like those very beautiful girls, often spending time and talking with Li Luo, and could get Li Luo to treat her a little more kindly.

Wouldn't that prove that she was just as beautiful as those very pretty girls?

This logic was somewhat incomprehensible to most boys.

But girls like Gao Yuqin really did think that way.

It was like when a simp gave them a bag worth several thousand yuan. She wouldn't think the simp was worthy of her, but rather that someone giving her a bag worth several thousand yuan meant she was worthy of that price.

Thus, she could join the circle of those who could afford thousand-yuan bags with a clear conscience.

This was a major reason why many simps spent a ton of money but still couldn't win over their goddesses.

Because for this segment of girls, they would subconsciously seek an external anchor, and then, based on the anchor's value, determine their own self-worth.

As the anchor became more valuable or outstanding, they would increasingly feel that they were more outstanding people, deserving of better things.

"So are you free on the day of the New Year's Gala?" Gao Yuqin asked. "I'll come find you."

"No need." Li Luo pointed to Ying Chanxi sitting in front of him. "I already have plans."

In comparison, girls like Ying Chanxi seemed all the more precious.

After the meeting ended, on the way from the second-year building to their classroom.

Ying Chanxi sidled up to Li Luo and asked, pretending to be nonchalant, "What did that class president from Class Seven want to talk to you about again?"

"She asked if I was free to hang out with her on the day of the New Year's Gala."

"And then?" Ying Chanxi's expression didn't change much, as if she didn't care at all.

"I said I already had plans." Li Luo chuckled. "Since I promised someone something, I can't just break it."

"Oh, is that so." Ying Chanxi nodded in satisfaction, but then asked again, "So if I hadn't asked you in advance, would you have agreed to her?"

"Then I would've gone to find Senior." Li Luo smiled and looked at Xu Youyu, who was walking beside Ying Chanxi. "Senior wouldn't mind, right?"

"Sure." Xu Youyu said with a grin, "I'll be on patrol all day then. You can just come and patrol with me."

"Is being the Student Council President that tiring?"

"I have to make sure every part of the event runs smoothly, but there are always some unexpected situations every year, so I definitely need to be ready to handle them at any time." Xu Youyu sighed. "I only got to enjoy it as a first-year. This year, I'll be busy."

"Next year it'll be Xixi's turn." Li Luo raised his eyebrows and looked at Ying Chanxi. "You'll be the one to inherit the position of Student Council President then."

"That's next year's business," Ying Chanxi said. "This year, you're accompanying me first."

"Then you can lend Li Luo to me next year." Xu Youyu playfully wrapped an arm around Ying Chanxi's neck, her right hand resting on her shoulder. "It's my last year in high school, I have to enjoy it too."

"Wh-what do you mean, lend..." Ying Chanxi stammered, "He's not my possession or anything, and if Senior wants someone to go around with, you'd have a whole crowd of people coming to you with just a word."

"Isn't it the same for Xixi?" Xu Youyu raised an eyebrow and smiled. "But we'll talk about that when the time comes. I'm going back to my classroom first."

When they reached the first floor of the second-year building, Xu Youyu waved to the two of them and turned to enter the classroom of Class Sixteen.

"You seem a little unhappy."

"I'm not."

"Then show me a smile?"

"Heh."

That night.

After coming home and taking a shower, Ying Chanxi lay in bed, hugged her Doraemon plushie, and gave it a couple of solid punches.

In the blink of an eye.

Time quickly arrived at Wednesday.

Early in the morning, Ying Chanxi knocked on Li Luo's bedroom door. Seeing no response, she simply opened the door and barged in.

"What the hell! I'm already up, what are you doing?"

The air conditioner in Li Luo's room was set to a high temperature, and he had taken off his shirt while sleeping.

He had just been woken up by Ying Chanxi's knocking and was about to get up when he saw her push the door open and walk straight in.

So Li Luo hurriedly pulled up the blanket to cover his upper body. "Get out, I'm not dressed."

"It's not... not like I haven't seen it before." Ying Chanxi blinked, her cheeks slightly flushed, whether from the hot air conditioner or something else.

The room was filled with Li Luo's scent, which she found very pleasant.

"It's this one, right?" Ying Chanxi walked to the head of the bed, tossed the sweater and school uniform hanging on the back of the chair to Li Luo on the bed, then turned to walk towards the bathroom in the room. "I'm borrowing the bathroom, Senior is using the one outside."

Li Luo watched speechlessly as Ying Chanxi walked into the bathroom. After the door closed, he quickly got up, put on his school pants first, and then picked up the sweater.

Just then, Xu Youyu walked in from outside, asking, "Li Luo, have you seen the clothes hangers on the balcony outside? I did laundry yesterday and forgot... uh..."

As soon as she entered the master bedroom, Xu Youyu saw Li Luo with his upper body bare, the sweater in a state of being half-on, half-off.

But soon enough, Li Luo quickly pulled the sweater over his body, and the scenery underneath was instantly hidden.

"You guys, can you not just barge into my room so casually?" Li Luo said with a look of exasperation. "Boys have a right to privacy too, you know."

"Alright, alright, I only saw a little bit." Xu Youyu rolled her eyes at him, not acting as shy as Ying Chanxi had. She even grabbed the hem of her own shirt and was about to lift it up. "I'll let you have a look too, how about we call it even?"

"Stop! Stop, stop, stop!" Li Luo quickly raised his hands to stop her. "I'm scared of you, alright? You can grab a few hangers from my wardrobe, Xixi probably put them here when she was tidying up."

"Oh, let me see." Xu Youyu walked to the wardrobe, opened one of the doors, and then seemed to freeze, not moving for a long time.

"What's wrong with you?" Li Luo was sitting on the edge of the bed putting on his socks. Seeing her motionless, he couldn't help but ask, "Are there none in there?"

"It's not a question of whether there are any..." Xu Youyu's expression was hard to describe. She looked at the contents of the wardrobe, then back at Li Luo, and couldn't help but say, "I didn't expect you to have this kind of hobby."

"What?" Li Luo was stunned for a moment. He looked over towards Xu Youyu and realized she had opened the wardrobe that Ying Chanxi usually used. He quickly explained, "Not that one! The one next to it!"

"The wardrobe you opened has all of Ying Chanxi's clothes in it."

"The wardrobe in her bedroom is too small, so she stuffed the extra ones in here."

"Oh, I see." Xu Youyu realized and then chuckled. "She really trusts you, huh? Isn't she afraid you'll do something bad with her clothes?"

"Don't tarnish an innocent man's name." Li Luo's face was full of dark lines. "Am I that kind of person?"

"Based on my observations, it's quite possible." Xu Youyu closed Ying Chanxi's wardrobe and took a few empty hangers from Li Luo's. "Just last week, I caught you at least a dozen times."

"That is a subconscious appreciation for beautiful things. The two cannot be lumped together," Li Luo said with a straight face.

"Hah." Xu Youyu, holding the hangers, walked out of the bedroom and waved at him. "I'll just take that as you complimenting me. I'll leave today's breakfast to you too. I want fried noodles."

"Got it." Li Luo put on his socks, stepped into his slippers, and went to the bathroom door, knocking. "Are you done yet? I need to brush my teeth and wash my face."

"Alright, alright, stop rushing me."

After finishing up in the bathroom with Ying Chanxi, Li Luo went to the kitchen to make breakfast.

Around six-thirty in the morning, the three of them were ready to go.

Li Luo slung Ying Zhicheng's guitar over his back and went to school with the two girls.

On the way, Li Luo suddenly remembered something and asked Ying Chanxi, "By the way, Uncle's guitar is pretty expensive, right? Did you tell him before you took it?"

"Huh?" Ying Chanxi paused, then shook her head. "It's just a guitar. Dad won't mind."

"He doesn't use it anyway. It's been collecting dust at home for years."

"It's a waste just sitting there. You can use it without worry."

(End of Chapter)
